source.description.zh-Hans: 瓜子的热门书目以中文长篇条漫为主。能找到《从姑获鸟开始》《原来，她们才是主角》等网文改编漫画。
source.description.zh-Hant: 瓜子的熱門書目以中文長篇條漫為主。能找到《從姑獲鳥開始》《原來，她們才是主角》等網文改編漫畫。
source.description.en: Guazi's popular shelf features long-running Chinese webcomics, including novel adaptations such as Cong Guhuo Niao Kaishi and It Turns Out, They Were the Protagonists.
